is_comment_sound.instructions: This unit is a definition with the comments it owns. Find the worst comment and choose the one option that best describes it. Choose justified only when every comment fits it.

criteria.justified: Every comment states what this code does - or why, when the code cannot say it - in the code's own words, and nothing else.
criteria.contradicted: A comment claims something the code shown does not do: a wrong count, a part the code does not contain, a different order, or return, error, or validation behavior the code does not have.
criteria.wording_unmapped: A comment names this code's parts in words the code does not use: coined labels, nicknames, value judgments (honest, clean, proper), or another part of the system's vocabulary (a caller's or a format's terms), so its nouns map to no identifier or behavior in this code.
criteria.digression: Part of a comment is about something other than this unit - a caller, another component, the language, a library - rather than what this unit does. A constraint this unit depends on, stated as the reason its code is written this way, is not a digression.
criteria.provenance: A comment depends on historic events outside the code - something measured, decided, renamed, or documented - rather than on the code as it reads now.
